original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Replace repeated Gauss-Jordan solves in the first PR6170 P104 shadow-relay fold with exact forward elimination and back substitution; preserve the canonical basic solution, every complete output word and source acceptance decision.
scope_change_reason: The source open question suggests caching rule matrices. The measured bottleneck is modular elimination, so this contribution changes only the solver instead.
bottleneck_link: Cheaper exact construction solves reduce time spent producing and testing candidate P104 words. This changes no supplier, native operator, invoice or selected bound.
stop_rule: Freeze the first source-equivalent improvement; measure at least five alternating complete folds, package it, and leave further algorithm changes to Open next questions.
evidence: PROFILE.json identifies elimination as the dominant cost. BENCHMARK.json is generated by five alternating complete baseline/candidate folds and binds every implementation hash. verify.py checks canonical solutions, invalid inputs, source corruption and both complete accepted solver variants. All ten final full-fold commands pass with identical words; medians 127.85968495812267 and 89.58335066703148 seconds, a reduction of 29.93620256739071 percent.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Does the same solver reduce time at every accepted fold site and across complete rebuilds?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The measured result is one actual first fold, not an end-to-end claim for every construction.
open_questions.first_step: Run the unchanged complete rebuild with the solver substitution and compare every emitted word and acceptance status.
open_questions.blocked_by: A separately budgeted benchmark of the remaining sites and larger system dimensions.

open_questions.question: Can exact elimination reuse factorizations across Newton rounds without changing candidate order?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The retained solver still rebuilds and eliminates a second system.
open_questions.first_step: Compare the two source-bound matrices, derive a certified update contract and include a complete invalidation test.
open_questions.blocked_by: No equality or low-rank relation between successive systems has been established.
